function.description: Use when you need computation, cleaning, aggregation, cross-file joins, large-file streaming, structured processing, or anything beyond simple preview tools. Python runs with the task context directory as the working directory and returns captured stdout as `output`. The execution timeout is fixed at 30 seconds. For tabular work (filtering, aggregation, projection, cross-file joins), use `pandas`: `df[df['col'] == ...]` and `df[['target_col']]` make WH-target column selection idiomatic, types are preserved automatically (no manual `int()`/`float()` casts), and `df.head()` / `df.dtypes` print the verification snapshot in one line. Available libs include pandas, numpy, pyarrow, polars, openpyxl. The `csv` module is fine only for trivial reads (a handful of rows).
function.name: execute_python

code.description: Python source to execute with the task context directory as CWD. Execution timeout is 30 seconds.
